# @stackline/moment-core 1.0.0

Moment.js-compatible parsing, formatting, duration, UTC, offset, and locale APIs for applications
that require stable Moment behavior.

Package: @stackline/moment-core
Package version: 1.0.0
Runtime API/version: Moment 2.30.1
Install: npm install @stackline/moment-core@1.0.0 --save-exact
Canonical docs: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/moment/
Versioned docs: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/moment/v1.0.0/
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stackline/moment-core
Repository: https://github.com/alexandroit/moment

Core entry points include moment(input), strict format parsing, moment.utc, moment.parseZone,
moment.duration, and moment.locale. Individual locales are available from
@stackline/moment-core/locale/<locale>.
